description: Failing cases of the object-type sweep (codec-corpus/prevalence/SOPCLASS_SWEEP.md), by IDC UID; fetched at test time, never committed. codec-corpus/scripts/sources/sopclass_fetch.py --fixtures fetches and derives them; then expect.py, sop-sweep-fixtures.ts and sop-sweep-checks.mjs run with that root.

fixtures.failure: Reformats of a PET series whose Rescale Slope differs between slices (two thirds of IDC's PET series) match neither SimpleITK nor each slice's values: the volume interpolates stored values and applies one slice's rescale to all.
fixtures.why: rescale differs between slices (80 rescales over 81 instances; Siemens / qin_pet_phantom)

fixtures.failure: Legacy Converted Enhanced PET (derived with highdicom) with a per-frame Pixel Value Transformation: frames after the first show values through frame 1's rescale.
Legacy Converted Enhanced CT (derived) whose frames are stored out of spatial order, with no dimension index: the viewer steps through the frames in stored order.
NLST TotalSegmentator segmentation whose Plane Orientation has the column direction reversed ([1,0,0,0,-1,0]) relative to its CT: drawn upside down on the CT.
Grayscale Softcopy Presentation State naming one image of a 326-slice CT: chosen in the series list, the viewer opens the CT at another slice with the state's window applied.
fixtures.why: spread by manufacturer then collection (GE MEDICAL SYSTEMS / qiba_ct_1c)

fixtures.failure: Label Map Segmentation stored with the Deflated Explicit VR Little Endian transfer syntax: the Share page's reader skips it ('no Study or Series Instance UID').
fixtures.why: spread by manufacturer then collection (QIICR / tcga_kirp)

fixtures.failure: Breast Projection X-Ray For Processing (Hologic): the Frame VOI LUT window (W 500, L 350) lies far below the stored values (about 5,400): every pixel draws black.
fixtures.why: spread by manufacturer then collection (HOLOGIC, Inc. / ea1141)
